fields.title: Advanced E-commerce System
fields.description:
This project is a high-performance backend service engineered with Django REST Framework (DRF) to provide a scalable and secure API for resource management. 
The architecture leverages JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for stateless authentication and a custom-built CRUD system that handles complex data relationships via optimized serializers. 
By implementing advanced filtering logic and JSONField integration for flexible metadata storage, the system ensures high data integrity while remaining adaptable to varying front-end requirements. 
The backend is designed with a focus on security, featuring strict CSRF configurations and role-based access to ensure protected communication between the client and the server.
features: Multi role system with Admin, Supplier, Customer and Delivery Personnel
Role based authentication and permission control
Complete CRUD operations for products, orders, inventory and deliveries
Advanced product search and filtering by name, category and price
Order management with status tracking and filtering
Supplier inventory management with stock monitoring
Pagination for product listings, orders and inventory
Admin analytics dashboard with revenue and order insights
Supplier dashboard for inventory and delivery tracking
Email notifications for order confirmation and delivery updates
Low stock alert system for suppliers
Real time notifications for order status and delivery assignment
RESTful API design with clean and scalable architecture
Optional payment integration with Stripe or PayPal
Deployment ready setup with production configuration
Well documented APIs with test coverage

fields.title: HCK - Community Management System
fields.description:
Herald Community Konnect (HCKonnect) is a web-based centralized platform that is
specially designed for the engagement of the college community and students. It assists
students, communities, and college administrators in uniting by offering different sections
for sharing announcements/news, managing events, uploading/sharing resources, and
engaging in discussions, ensuring better engagement of students in college communities.
